current_claim_ceiling: Palmer Adelie breeding distributions show a short-lived, history-dependent association between a previously defined colony-wide reproductive state and subsequent within-island redistribution. The association is not independently reproduced by the frozen mean-creched-chicks-per-monitored-nest endpoint, and its individual carrier remains unresolved.
